questions.question: What food did a boy bring that Jesus used to feed a crowd of about 5,000 men?
questions.answer: Five barley loaves and two fish

questions.question: In the parable of the lost son, what did the father do when he saw his son returning?
questions.answer: He ran to him, embraced him, and kissed him.

finalJeopardy.question: According to 1 Corinthians 13:13, what three things remain, and which is the greatest?
finalJeopardy.answer: Faith, hope, and love remain. The greatest is love.
